summary: A general-purpose rail tank car at standard gauge: a 2.8 m steel tank with ellipsoidal heads and girth seams… joints manway_hatch, hand_brake, truck_f_axle_0, truck_f_axle_1, truck_r_axle_0, truck_r_axle_1; options paint; sockets socket_coupler_front, socket_coupler_rear, socket_platform, outlet, manway.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.rail_tank_car or place "prefab": "rail_tank_car" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
